name: Viram Suvarn Limited
about: Viram Suvarn Limited engages in the wholesale, retail, and trading of branded jewelry in India. It offers rings, bracelet, necklace, ear chain, earring, pendant, chain, magalsuta, zuda, toe ring, anklet, and bangle. The company was formerly known as Veeram Securities Limited and changed its name to Viram Suvarn Limited in November 2027. Viram Suvarn Limited was incorporated in 2011 and is based in Ahmedabad, India.
